body.name: PsiTG
body.def: \(\Psi_{T,G}(p_T)\) is obtained by declaring exactly the primitive structural features \(e\in\mathcal I_T\) with \(Z_e(T,p_T)>0\), declaring the remaining features by \(Z_e(T,p_T)=0\), and applying the finite latent-and-selection projection rules; it is true exactly when the projected graph equals \(G\)
